explain.say: Look at the first bar: the peregrine falcon. When it dives from high in the sky to catch a bird, it goes over 320 kilometres per hour, faster than a racing car! Wow. Can you find the fastest land animal?

items.ask: How fast can a cheetah run?

explain.say: The cheetah! Look at its bar: about 110 kilometres per hour, as fast as a car on a motorway. But it can only sprint for about 20 to 30 seconds before it gets too hot and tired. Which animal do you think can keep going longer?

explain.say: The pronghorn of North America! Look at its bar: it is a bit slower than a cheetah, but it can run fast for kilometres. Then the ostrich, the fastest bird on two legs. Can you find the human?

faq.q: What is the fastest animal in the world?
faq.a: The peregrine falcon. In a hunting dive it can go over 320 kilometres per hour, and one was measured at about 389 kilometres per hour.

faq.q: How fast can a cheetah run?
faq.a: About 100 to 120 kilometres per hour in short sprints of around 20 to 30 seconds. It is the fastest land animal.

faq.q: Is a cheetah faster than a falcon?
faq.a: On land the cheetah wins, but a diving peregrine falcon is about three times faster than a cheetah.
asks: Which is faster, cheetah or falcon?

faq.a: A deer-like animal of North America. It can run about 88 kilometres per hour and keep up high speed for much longer than a cheetah.
asks: Which animal runs fast the longest?

faq.q: How fast is the fastest human?
faq.a: Usain Bolt reached about 44.7 kilometres per hour during his 100 metres world record of 9.58 seconds in 2009.

facts: A diving peregrine falcon can exceed 320 km/h, making it the fastest animal.
Cheetahs can reach about 100 to 120 km/h in short bursts.
Usain Bolt set the 100 metres world record of 9.58 seconds in 2009.

quiz.say: Which animal is the fastest of all?
quiz.show: Which animal is the fastest of all?

quiz.say: Why can a cheetah only sprint for a short time?
quiz.show: Why can a cheetah only sprint for a short time?

options.show: It gets too hot and tired
options.say: It gets too hot and tired

options.show: It is scared of the ground
options.say: It is scared of the ground

quiz.why: Sprinting uses huge energy and heats the cheetah's body, so it must stop after about 20 to 30 seconds.

wrong.1: Cheetahs have long legs built for speed.
wrong.2: Cheetahs are not scared of the ground; they just overheat.
